```{r}
library("here")         # file logistics
library("lme4")         # mixed effects metric
library("lmerTest")     # p values
library("tidyverse")    # code logistics
library("broom.mixed")  # model outputs as data frames
library("emmeans")      # estimated marginal means
library("patchwork")    # merge plots
library("report")       # apa reporting
library("gt")           # latex tables
library("effectsize")   # partial eta sq calculations

# TO "CENTER" CATEGORICAL PREDICTORS, set the coding to contr.sum (deviations from the average)
options(scipen = 999, contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
path <- here("_data", "_intermediary_data", "models")
```


```{r}
# read in data
wave_2_dfs <- readRDS(here("_data", "_intermediary_data", "wave_2_dfs.RDS"))
lyrics_df <- readRDS(here("_data", "_primary_data", "lyrics_df.RDS"))

df <- bind_rows(wave_2_dfs$wave_2_lyrics |> 
                  mutate(text = "Lyrics") |>
                  select(participant_ID, item_ID, value, rating, text), 
                wave_2_dfs$wave_2_speeches |> 
                  mutate(text = "Speeches") |>
                  select(participant_ID, item_ID, value, rating, text))

df <- df |> mutate(value = as.factor(value), text = as.factor(text))

genre_df <- merge(wave_2_dfs$wave_2_lyrics |> 
                    select(item_ID, participant_ID, genre), 
                  lyrics_df |> select(item_ID, artist_topic_bin_labels), 
                  by = "item_ID") |>
  select(genre, artist_topic_bin_labels) |> unique()
```


```{r}
build_anova_gt <- function(anova_obj,
                           eta_df,
                           title = "Type III ANOVA Results") {

  # Format ANOVA table
  anova_df <- anova_obj |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect") |>
    mutate(Effect = trimws(Effect))

  # Format eta_df
  eta_df <- eta_df |>
    select(Effect, Eta2_partial) |>
    mutate(Effect = trimws(Effect)) |>
    distinct()

  # 3. Join
  df <- left_join(anova_df, eta_df, by = "Effect")

  # 4. Format p-values
  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      p_fmt = case_when(
        is.na(`Pr(>F)`)  ~ NA_character_,
        `Pr(>F)` < .0001 ~ "p < .0001",
        `Pr(>F)` < .001  ~ "p < .001",
        TRUE             ~ sprintf("p = %.3f", `Pr(>F)`)
      ),

      F_fmt = sprintf("F(%d, %s) = %.2f",
                      NumDF,
                      format(round(DenDF), scientific = FALSE),
                      `F value`),

      eta_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", Eta2_partial)
    )

  # 5. Group effects
  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      Group = case_when(
        !str_detect(Effect, ":") ~ "Main Effects",
        str_count(Effect, ":") == 1 ~ "Two-Way Interactions",
        str_count(Effect, ":") == 2 ~ "Three-Way Interactions",
        TRUE ~ "Four-Way Interactions"
      )
    )

  # 6. Build gt table
  gt_tbl <- df |>
    select(Group, Effect, F_fmt, p_fmt, eta_fmt) |>      # CI removed
    gt(groupname_col = "Group") |>
    cols_label(
      Effect  = "Effect",
      F_fmt   = md("$F$"),
      p_fmt   = md("$p$"),
      eta_fmt = md("$\\eta^2_{partial}$")
    ) |>
    cols_align("center", columns = c(F_fmt, p_fmt, eta_fmt)) |>
    
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
    
    
  tab_header(title = title)

  gt_tbl
}
```

```{r}
apa_emm_pairs <- function(model, specs, digits = 2) {
  
  # Compute EMMs + pairwise contrasts
  cmp <- emmeans::emmeans(
      model, specs, 
      lmer.df = "satterthwaite",
      lmerTest.limit = 300210
    ) |>
    emmeans::contrast("pairwise", adjust = "tukey") |>
    broom::tidy()
  
  # Format + compute Cohen's d
  result <- cmp |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      df  = round(df, 1),
      est = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), estimate),
      se  = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), std.error),
      t   = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), statistic),
      
      # APA p-value
      p   = dplyr::case_when(
        adj.p.value < .001 ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("= %.3f", adj.p.value)
      ),
      
      # Cohen's d approximation
      d_value = statistic / sqrt(df),
      d_fmt   = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), d_value),
      
      # Full APA sentence
      apa = sprintf(
        "%s: difference = %s, SE = %s, t(%s) = %s, p %s, d = %s.",
        contrast, est, se, df, t, p, d_fmt
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(apa)
  
  return(result)
}
apa_emm_pairs(speeches4_mod,specs = ~ Ethnicity)
```

```{r}
apa_emm_ethnicity_by_spectrum <- function(model, sig_only = FALSE) {
  
  # 1. Compute emmeans by Ethnicity within Spectrum
  cmp <- emmeans::emmeans(
    model,
    specs = ~ Ethnicity | spectrum,
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite",
    lmerTest.limit = 300000,
    pbkrtest.limit = 300000
  ) |>
    emmeans::contrast("pairwise", adjust = "tukey") |>
    broom::tidy()
  
  # 3. APA-format p-values
  cmp <- cmp |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      df = round(df, 1),
      SE = std.error,
      p_fmt = dplyr::case_when(
        adj.p.value < .0001 ~ "< .0001",
        adj.p.value < .001  ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("= %.3f", adj.p.value)
      ),
      t_fmt = sprintf("t(%s) = %.2f", df, statistic)
    )
  
  # 4. Optionally keep only significant comparisons
  if (sig_only) {
    cmp <- cmp |> dplyr::filter(adj.p.value < .05)
  }
  
  # 5. Clean output
  cmp |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      spectrum,
      Contrast = contrast,
      Estimate = round(estimate, 2),
      SE = round(SE, 2),
      t = t_fmt,
      p = p_fmt, 
      d = sprintf("%.2f", statistic / sqrt(df)) 
    )
}

apa_ethspec <- apa_emm_ethnicity_by_spectrum(speeches4_mod, sig_only = TRUE)
apa_ethspec
```

```{r}
print_apa_comparisons <- function(df) {
  
  df$Contrast_clean <- gsub("[()]", "", df$Contrast)
  
  apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    sprintf(
      "For %s participants, %s showed a difference of %.2f (SE = %.2f), %s, p %s, d = %.2f.",
      row[["spectrum"]],
      row[["Contrast_clean"]],
      as.numeric(row[["Estimate"]]),
      as.numeric(row[["SE"]]),
      row[["t"]],
      row[["p"]],
      as.numeric(row[["d"]])
    )
  }) |> 
    paste(collapse = "\n")
}
```

```{r}
apa_emm_ethnicity_by_spectrum <- function(model, sig_only = FALSE) {

  # 1. Compute emmeans contrasts
  cmp <- emmeans::emmeans(
    model,
    specs = ~ Ethnicity | spectrum,
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite",
    lmerTest.limit = 300000,
    pbkrtest.limit = 300000) |>
    
    emmeans::contrast("pairwise", adjust = "tukey") |>
    broom::tidy()

  # 2. Keep only contrasts involving Black
  cmp <- cmp |>
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(contrast, "Black/African American"))

  # 3. Reorder contrasts so Black is always first
  reorder_black <- function(x) {
    parts <- strsplit(x, " - ")[[1]]
    g1 <- parts[1]
    g2 <- parts[2]

    # If both are Black → remove later by filtering
    if (g1 == "Black/African American" && g2 == "Black/African American") {
      return(NA_character_)
    }

    # Correct order
    if (g1 == "Black/African American") {
      return(x)
    }

    # Otherwise if Black is in group2, flip to group1
    paste0("Black/African American - ", g1)
  }

  cmp <- cmp |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      new_contrast = purrr::map_chr(contrast, reorder_black),
      flipped = new_contrast != contrast & !is.na(new_contrast),
      estimate = ifelse(flipped, -estimate, estimate),
      statistic = ifelse(flipped, -statistic, statistic),
      contrast = new_contrast) |>
      
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(contrast))

  # 4. Format APA stats
  cmp <- cmp |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      
      # round degrees of freedom to single decimal
      df = round(df, 1),
      SE = std.error,
      
      p_fmt = dplyr::case_when(
        adj.p.value < .0001 ~ "< .0001",
        adj.p.value < .001  ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("= %.3f", adj.p.value)),
      
        t_fmt = sprintf("t(%s) = %.2f", df, statistic),
        d = sprintf("%.2f", statistic / sqrt(df)))

  # focus on significant results only?
  if (sig_only) {cmp <- cmp |> dplyr::filter(adj.p.value < .05)}

  # 5. Clean final output
  cmp |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      spectrum,
      Contrast = contrast,
      Estimate = round(estimate, 2),
      SE = round(SE, 2),
      t = t_fmt,
      p = p_fmt,
      d)}

model = speeches4_mod
apa_ethspec <- apa_emm_ethnicity_by_spectrum(speeches4_mod, sig_only = TRUE)
apa_ethspec
```

```{r}
model <- speeches4_mod

cmp <- emmeans::emmeans(
  model,
  specs = ~ Ethnicity | value * spectrum,
  lmer.df = "satterthwaite",
  lmerTest.limit = 300000,
  pbkrtest.limit = 300000) |>
  
  emmeans::contrast("pairwise", adjust = "tukey") |>
  broom::tidy() |>
  dplyr::filter(adj.p.value < .05) |>
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    df  = round(df, 1),
    SE  = std.error,
    adj.p.value = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.p.value < .0001 ~ "< .0001",
      adj.p.value < .001  ~ "< .001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("= %.3f", adj.p.value)))


put_black_first <- function(cmp_df, black_label = "(Black/African American)") {
  
  cmp_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(value, spectrum) |>
    tidyr::separate(
      contrast,
      into = c("g1", "g2"),
      sep = " - ",
      remove = FALSE) |>
    
    dplyr::mutate(
      flip = g2 == black_label,
      g1_new = dplyr::if_else(flip, g2, g1),
      g2_new = dplyr::if_else(flip, g1, g2),
      estimate  = dplyr::if_else(flip, -estimate, estimate),
      statistic = dplyr::if_else(flip, -statistic, statistic),
      contrast  = paste0(g1_new, " - ", g2_new)) |>
    
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(-g1, -g2, -g1_new, -g2_new, -flip)
}

cmp_fixed <- put_black_first(cmp)

contrasts_gt <- function(df, title = "Pairwise Comparisons") {
  df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      contrast = contrast |>
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\(", "") |>
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\)", "")
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Value    = value,
      Spectrum = spectrum,
      Contrast = contrast,
      Estimate = round(estimate, 2),
      SE       = round(SE, 2),
      Statistic = sprintf("t(%s) = %.2f", df, round(statistic, 2)),
      `p-value` = adj.p.value
    ) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::tab_header(title = title) |>
    gt::cols_align(
      align = "center",
      columns = c(Estimate, SE, Statistic, `p-value`)
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size = 12,
      data_row.padding = px(4)
    )
}

gt_contrast_table <- contrasts_gt(
  cmp_fixed,
  title = "Significant Contrasts: Ethnicity and Political Leaning by Value"
)

gt_contrast_table
gtsave(gt_contrast_table, here("tables", "wave_2_speeches_ethnicity_value_contrasts.tex"))
```

```{r}
apa_emm_ethnicity_by_value <- function(model, sig_only = FALSE) {
  
  # 1. Compute emmeans by Ethnicity within Value
  cmp <- emmeans::emmeans(
    model,
    specs = ~ Ethnicity | value,
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite",
    lmerTest.limit = 300000,
    pbkrtest.limit = 300000
  ) |>
    emmeans::contrast("pairwise", adjust = "tukey") |>
    broom::tidy()
  
  # 2. Format stats
  cmp <- cmp |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      df = round(df, 1),
      SE = std.error,
      p_fmt = dplyr::case_when(
        adj.p.value < .0001 ~ "< .0001",
        adj.p.value < .001  ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("= %.3f", adj.p.value)
      ),
      t_fmt = sprintf("t(%s) = %.2f", df, statistic),
      d = statistic / sqrt(df)
    )
  
  # 3. Filter sig if requested
  if (sig_only) {
    cmp <- cmp |> dplyr::filter(adj.p.value < .05)
  }
  
  # 4. Clean and return
  cmp |> 
    dplyr::transmute(
      value,
      Contrast = contrast,
      Estimate = round(estimate, 2),
      SE = round(SE, 2),
      t = t_fmt,
      p = p_fmt,
      d = sprintf("%.2f", d)
    )
}

apa_print_pairs_by_value <- function(df) {
  
  df |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      sentence = sprintf(
        "[%s] %s: difference = %.2f, SE = %.2f, %s, p %s, d = %.2f.",
        value, Contrast, Estimate, SE, t, p, as.numeric(d)
      )
    ) |> 
    dplyr::pull(sentence) |> 
    paste(collapse = "\n")
}
```
